Refurbishment Underway in Historic Carolwood Pacific Railroad Room at Disney's Wilderness Lodge

Shannen Ace

Published: November 17, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
0:00 / 0:00 Instaread
Sponsored by

Crews are replacing portions of the wood flooring in the Carolwood Pacific Room at Boulder Ridge Villas at Disney’s Wilderness Lodge, a lounge featuring authentic artifacts from Walt Disney’s personal backyard railroad.

Carolwood Pacific Room Flooring Replacement

We found the room, formerly the Iron Spike Room, roped off for the work. It sits off the Boulder Ridge Villas lobby, honoring Walt’s love of trains.

Two original cars and track from his one-eighth-scale Carolwood Pacific Railroad sit here, lent by the Walt Disney Family Museum.

Some boards were gone and a worker was fitting new ones.

The new planks look lighter in spots; further staining is unclear. The lounge got new furniture and rugs in 2023, pictured below.

It appears to be routine upkeep, not a redesign.
